name: Naomi
bio: After 10 years in the care industry looking after the elderly, I turned my focus and care to man's (and woman's) best friend. I've always had animals in my life, and since having two dogs of my own, working with dogs has become a reality. I want to give the dogs the best time on their walks and let their personalities shine. There's no better feeling than seeing a wiggly, happy dog so excited to see you, even in the snow!
